description: Looks up a domain's public DNS: SPF (one record, how it ends, an estimate of its DNS lookups against the limit of 10), DMARC (policy none, quarantine or reject, and whether reports are sent), MX (and the mail provider when recognisable), and DKIM keys under common selector names (google, selector1/selector2, k1, s1/s2, default, resend and others). A DKIM key that isn't found under those names isn't necessarily missing. Returns findings with plain-word fixes and DNS records to copy (a starter DMARC with p=none, the next step to p=quarantine). Reads DNS only; it can't see whether mail actually passes. Limited to 30 checks an hour per caller (shared with the other checks); results are cached for 10 minutes.

domain.description: the email domain, e.g. example.com (an email address or website address works too)

name: check_email_security
title: Is this domain's email set up so it lands in the inbox and can't easily be faked?
